pages: Marguerite Okonjo, seventeen, dark-skinned, dark hair in two plaits pinned back, in a plain grey wool dress with a knitted shawl, writes in a ledger a foot thick on a corner desk. Middle distance: a gas ring, a stack of returned books. Background: the food office in the Corn Exchange, tall window. Light: grey daylight, low and cold.

Marguerite Okonjo, seventeen, dark-skinned, in her grey wool dress and knitted shawl, counts with a pencil down one returned ration book open on her palm, coupons marked off with a shop stamp. Middle distance: the thick ledger, a stack of books. Background: the gas ring, the window. Light: flat grey daylight.

Marguerite Okonjo, seventeen, dark-skinned, in her grey wool dress and knitted shawl, holds one pair of nail scissors over an open ration book, one coupon still on its dotted line. Middle distance: the ledger, an enamel cup on the gas ring. Background: the office door, the tall window. Light: grey daylight, low and cold.

Marguerite Okonjo, seventeen, dark-skinned, in her grey wool dress and knitted shawl, draws with one pencil a long row of tiny terraced house fronts on a sheet of paper. Middle distance: the ledger, two returned books, the inkpot. Background: the office wall, the tall window. Light: evening light, low and yellow.

Marguerite Okonjo, seventeen, dark-skinned, in her grey wool dress and knitted shawl, keeps one finger on a line of the open ledger at the last house, reading down the column. Middle distance: the pencil, the shop cancellation sheet. Background: the gas ring, the window. Light: evening light, low and yellow.

Marguerite Okonjo, seventeen, dark-skinned, in her grey wool dress and knitted shawl, runs one finger down a shop cancellation sheet, a column of marked coupons. Middle distance: the thick ledger, the pencil, a tin of clips. Background: the office door, the tall window. Light: flat grey daylight, low and cold.

Marguerite Okonjo, seventeen, dark-skinned, in her grey wool dress and knitted shawl, sits with one unissued ration book still in its paper wrapper on the desk before her. Middle distance: the thick ledger, the pencil, a tin of clips. Background: the gas ring, the tall window. Light: grey daylight, low and cold.

Marguerite Okonjo, seventeen, dark-skinned, in her grey wool dress and knitted shawl, sets one pencil point to the margin and works out a small sum, four coupons in a row above it. Middle distance: the open ledger, a returned book. Background: the office wall, the window. Light: lamp light, low and yellow.

Marguerite Okonjo, seventeen, dark-skinned, in her grey wool dress and knitted shawl, sits with one flat hand laid on the shut ledger and does not open it. Middle distance: the pencil, a blank book, the gas ring. Background: the office door, dusk in the window. Light: dusk, low and grey.

Marguerite Okonjo, seventeen, dark-skinned, in her grey wool dress and knitted shawl, sits on the edge of the desk turning one pencil over slowly in her fingers. Middle distance: the open ledger, the shop cancellation sheet, an inkpot. Background: the gas ring, the tall window. Light: lamp light, low and yellow.

Marguerite Okonjo, seventeen, dark-skinned, in her grey wool dress and knitted shawl, opens one pair of nail scissors over a blank ration book spread out on the desk. Middle distance: the ledger, the pencil, a manila envelope. Background: the office door, the tall window. Light: grey daylight, low and cold.

Marguerite Okonjo, seventeen, dark-skinned, in her grey wool dress and knitted shawl, walks the wet terraced street with one thick ledger under her arm and raises her other hand to a painted door. Middle distance: a lamp standard, a low garden wall. Background: the row of house fronts, rain. Light: lamplight, low and yellow, in rain.

Marguerite Okonjo, seventeen, dark-skinned, in her grey wool dress and knitted shawl, sits at a scrubbed table with one pencil over a blank ration book. Middle distance: an envelope, a cancellation sheet, a cup on a saucer. Background: a chair with a shawl over it by the fire. Light: low firelight.

An old woman of sixty-eight in a dark headscarf and a grey knitted shawl, thin hands folded on the cloth, looks down at one open ration book in front of her. Middle distance: a scrubbed table, an enamel cup. Background: the fire, a chair pushed back. Light: low firelight, warm and dim.

An old woman of sixty-eight in a dark headscarf and a grey knitted shawl, holds one yellow bar of hard soap in both hands above the scrubbed table. Middle distance: a bowl, washing soda, the ration book. Background: the fire, a steamy kettle on the hob. Light: low firelight, warm and dim.

Marguerite Okonjo, seventeen, dark-skinned, in her grey wool dress and knitted shawl, cuts one coupon out of the ration book with nail scissors along its dotted line. Middle distance: a manila envelope, the shop cancellation sheet. Background: the scrubbed table, the low fire. Light: low firelight on the paper edges.

Marguerite Okonjo, seventeen, dark-skinned, in her grey wool dress and knitted shawl, lays one pencil down beside the ledger open at the returned column and looks at the figure. Middle distance: the cancellation sheet, an enamel cup, the ration book. Background: the fire, dusk at the window. Light: low firelight, then dusk.

Marguerite Okonjo, seventeen, dark-skinned, in her grey wool dress and knitted shawl, counts four coupons laid out in a row on the blotter, one pencil point resting beside a fifth. Middle distance: the ledger, an inkpot, a returned book. Background: the gas ring, the window. Light: grey daylight, low and cold.

Marguerite Okonjo, seventeen, dark-skinned, in her grey wool dress and knitted shawl, lays one flat hand down a ruled column of names in the open ledger. Middle distance: the pencil, a returned book face down, an inkpot. Background: the gas ring, the tall window. Light: grey daylight, low and cold.

Marguerite Okonjo, seventeen, dark-skinned, in her grey wool dress and knitted shawl, presses one flat hand on a single file sheet pulled out of the folder. Middle distance: the shut ledger, the pencil, a brass clip. Background: the filing shelf, the tall window. Light: grey daylight, low and cold outside.

Marguerite Okonjo, seventeen, dark-skinned, in her grey wool dress and knitted shawl, stands at a wooden counter and slides one sealed envelope across it. Middle distance: the thick ledger under her arm, string ties on the counter. Background: a post office window, rain running down. Light: grey light through the rain.

Marguerite Okonjo, seventeen, dark-skinned, in her grey wool dress and knitted shawl, walks the wet street with the ledger under one arm and pushes one small receipt slip into her coat pocket. Middle distance: a lamp standard, puddles. Background: terraced house fronts, rain. Light: lamplight, low and yellow, in rain.
